notes.title: New Physics Update!
notes.content:
[h2]Ninjas![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37684770/2d70ba3fb2971ed5873b9d373927c97777ef4ff6.jpg[/img]

You spoke, and we have listened. Disc Ninja New Physics update introduces something many of you asked for – new physics mechanics for all of your throwing pleasures! 

[b]A gentle breeze over the World of Disc Ninja![/b]

Disc throwing physics was often covered in your reviews and various feedback forms we received after the premiere. And while plenty of you liked how the game works, we have seen opinions that it should be changed! And so, we decided to gather our best shamans and summon new winds to carry your discs further and make them more responsive to your own techniques.

[b]A keen mind to oversee the effects[/b]

But you don’t need to take our word for it. To ensure that the disc physics is accurate, we were joined by a professional disc golfer. Together we have tried to find the most optimal solution to satisfy experienced disc golfers and complete amateurs. 

[b]A willing hand to check the results[/b]

Whether you’re a new player, a Disc Ninja veteran, or someone who didn’t enjoy the game as much as we hoped for, we urge you to try the results of our work. Furthermore, to make it even easier for you to share your feedback with us, we launched [url=https://discord.gg/xgWMhBDK4e]a brand new Discord server[/url], where you’re more than welcome to come, share your feelings with us, and hopefully stay longer. You can find the server here.

[b]A soft whisper hanging in the wind[/b]

But wait, there’s more... Can you hear it? Listen carefully. There is a sound reverberating softly in the wind. What does it say? ‘New maps,’ it hums? ‘New discs’ it buzzes? ‘A more classical approach to Disc Golf? Coming soon? Ah, but it’s gone. A moment has passed, and now only silence lingers. Well, we’ll see each other soon enough and find out what it means for the world of Disc Ninja.

Until then, thank you, good luck, and have fun!

notes.title: Disc Ninja debuts on Pico Store!
notes.content:
[h2]Ninjas![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37684770/9c9b76bd49c6ef426e4a21761561b2a83ab726f9.png[/img]

We are excited to announce that as of today, our [b]Disc Ninja game can also be purchased from the Chinese Pico Store![/b] 🎉🥳 

Also, we are currently working on a number of improvements to Disc Ninja and hope to have more to say soon. Nothing left to say, but to encourage you to train and keep improving your skills!

You never know when you might need 'em...

In addition to the Pico Store, the game is also available on Steam VR, Oculus Rift and Quest. Thanks to the [b]crossplay feature[/b], users of different platforms (within one region) can play together in multiplayer mode.

notes.title: Celebrating the Oculus Quest release and the bright future of Disc Ninja
notes.content:
Ninjas, today we celebrate the Oculus Quest release of Disc Ninja, but that doesn’t mean we have forgotten about Steam - far from it! While the VR market remains fragmented, with plenty of different devices, our goal remains singular – to share Disc Ninja with as many players as it is doable. After all, without you, any of this wouldn’t be possible in the first place.

Without further ado, it’s time to unveil what the future holds for Disc Ninja on Steam. And let us tell you - it’s looking bright! 

What new features Disc Ninja on Steam will receive later this year:
[list]
[*] New maps – with various difficulty levels, filled to the brim with deadly traps, hidden shortcuts, and breathtaking sights to behold
[*] New collectibles to gather! Soon you will be able to expand your Ninja wardrobe and showcase your style to other ninjas.
[*] New game modes – the main principle of the game remains the same, but things will get hectic!
[*] Other surprises we don’t want to share just yet but will unveil in time.
[/list]
We’re working hard on bringing these features to you as soon as possible! But before we do, we need to test it on various devices and have 100% certainty that you have the best possible experience at your disposal. Stay strong, Ninjas, and soon we will celebrate Steam updates aplenty.

notes.title: [UPDATE] EA008 - Valve Index & 2 new maps
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=7chf_NBCiqQ;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]Valve Index support and 2 new maps have arrived to Disc Ninja![/h2]
Grab your Valve Index VR headset and become the Disc Ninja master!
Join us on our pilgrim at Meditation Path. Climb a mountain and reach the dragon, but don't hesitate to stay awhile and listen to your mind. Are you ready for the Cliffhanger? Face the height and cross the bridge hang in the mountains, or find another way to reach your destination.

[h2]Also[/h2]
[list][*]Few, little bug fixes
[*]Increased performance
[*]Preparations for new features
[/list]
